When To Book

Knowing when to book is as important as knowing where.

We track Club Med availability and pricing so you can see if a resort is about to sell out, or if prices have recently dropped and now is a good time to book.

Live Signals

Current booking signals across Club Med ski resorts

Prices updated daily. Click any resort for full price history.

Signal Guide

What each signal means

Favourable

"Conditions suggest a reasonable time to book."

Price is stable or has plateaued at a historically favourable level, or availability signals suggest further drops are unlikely. The data points toward acting now — but timing is yours to judge.

Watch

"Price has moved recently. Direction is still resolving."

Price has shifted meaningfully in the past week, or the booking window suggests movement is likely soon. The picture isn't clear enough to signal either way — Check back for an updated signal — and set an alert so you don't miss it.

Monitoring

"The picture is still developing."

Price has shifted from recent levels and the trend hasn't yet stabilised. Availability is still open, but windows can close quickly — check back for an updated signal before the week moves.
